verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say you can add a backend to your app from the builder, but only to store and manage data and content. Server-side functions and third-party integrations such as payments or email are not documented. The MCP connector only brings external data in as context for building, not as app integrations. Missing for 10: documented server-side functions, payment integration, email integration, any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: You can also [add a backend](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/32640822050199) to your app to securely store and manage data.
Generate and design your frontend in Figma Make, then create a backend to manage your content.
